title: Atomic Dissolution
body:
Syntax: perform atomic dissolution <target>

Description: A Dust Release (Kekkei Tota) attack that strikes one target. A weakened target deals 15% less damage.  Requires Dust Release (Kekkei Tota) and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 10300-10700. 40% chance to inflict weakened. Unlocks at level 100. Costs 150 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 28 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
